articles.title: How Crypto Stopped Waiting for Congress and Learned to Love the Regulators
articles.description: After the Clarity Act failed in the Senate, the SEC, CFTC, and the Fed moved within days to write crypto's rules themselves. Will it be enough?

articles.title: AI Agents Are Racing to Make Quantum-Safe Bitcoin Cheap—And Winning
articles.description: An open competition run by StarkWare, Yukon Research, and Eigen Labs drove the estimated cost of building a quantum-safe Bitcoin transaction from about $320 to roughly $67, with AI models topping the leaderboards.

articles.title: Google Just Made Free 1080p AI Video Generation Available to Anyone
articles.description: Google Vids now lets any Google account holder generate free HD AI video using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, with new scene, timing, and watermark controls.

articles.title: US Prosecutors Want $84.2 Million From a Bank Tied to Tether
articles.description: Federal prosecutors are targeting a Montana payments firm and a Caribbean bank accused of moving money without a license.

articles.title: AI Agents Hacked Their Own Test Environment to Cheat, Cybersecurity Firm Finds
articles.description: Darktrace's new Signal Labs found AI agents hacking their own evaluation environment to fake a perfect score—and tricking coding assistants into running unauthorized network attacks.

articles.title: Google Built an AI That Hunts Its Own Security Bugs
articles.description: Google's PageBreak agent autonomously finds and verifies real vulnerabilities in its own web apps, cutting through the flood of noisy AI-generated security reports.

articles.title: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away
articles.description: The two stablecoin issuers blacklisted a wallet labeled "Bitget Exploiter 8," locking about $318,000 in USDC and USDT—but the attacker swapped most funds into unfreezable ETH before they could act.

articles.title: OpenAI Is Building a $500 per Month ChatGPT Pro Max Plan, Leaks Suggest
articles.description: Leaked code strings and screenshots point to a new tier that would cost 25 times more than ChatGPT Plus, aimed at people who need the bot to work faster, not just longer.

articles.title: Bitget Hack Losses Climb to $387M: Here’s What Happened, and Why North Korea Is a Suspect
articles.description: An attacker faked internal transfer requests to drain $387.5 million from Bitget's hot and warm wallets, and the exchange's CEO says the fingerprints look like Pyongyang's.

articles.title: Magic Eden Warns Old Ethereum NFT Listings Are Exposed to Payment Processor Exploit
articles.description: A flaw in Limit Break's Payment Processor V2 put old Magic Eden Ethereum listings at risk, prompting a whitehat rescue of more than 23,000 NFTs.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rally Slows as $15.6 Billion Options Expiry Hits—XRP and Solana Keep Climbing
articles.description: Pullback or reversal? Here's what the charts suggest for BTC.

articles.title: Strategy Wants Its Preferred Stock Dividends to Accrue 365 Days a Year
articles.description: STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD would accrue dividends on weekends and holidays, in a move Strategy says will dampen volatility.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley Joins NEXTPredict as Prediction Markets Bet on 'More Institutional' Play
articles.description: The bulk of prediction market trades are still sports bets, while valuations are predicated on rising institutional interest.

articles.title: Morning Minute: BlackRock Leans Deeper Into Tokenization with Ondo
articles.description: The biggest financial institutions in the world are bringing more products onchain, and the pace is accelerating.

articles.title: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth Holds Bitcoin in a Coinbase Wallet, Filing Shows
articles.description: Two entries in his annual disclosure put the holding somewhere between $16,000 and $65,000, alongside more than $1 million in cash.

articles.title: KelpDAO Developer Sues LayerZero Over $292M Bridge Exploit
articles.description: Evercrest says LayerZero approved the single-verifier configuration in writing multiple times, then warned a different developer about it.

articles.title: Researchers Publish 'Zcash-Style' Design for Private Bitcoin Transfers
articles.description: The Shielded Bitcoin spec hides senders, receivers and amounts, but leaves how BTC enters and exits the system to a later paper.

articles.title: Federal Reserve Unveils Stablecoin Rules on Reserves and Capital
articles.description: The central bank opened two proposals for comment under the GENIUS Act, requiring issuers it supervises to back tokens fully with safe assets and creating an application process for banks seeking to issue stablecoins.

articles.title: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets
articles.description: A newly created wallet drained hot and cold reserves labeled as belonging to Bitget across multiple blockchains in under an hour.

articles.title: Humans Are Reading Your ChatGPT Chats, New Lawsuit Claims
articles.description: A proposed class action accuses OpenAI of quietly routing real conversations to outside contractors through a program called Project Lily—without telling users first.

articles.title: Meta's New AI Toy Is a Keychain That Watches, Listens, and Never Blinks
articles.description: Muse Charm is Meta's palm-sized gadget for talking to its Muse AI agent on the go. It has cameras, a fingerprint sensor, and its own cell connection.

articles.title: AI Can Now Doxx Your Anonymous Accounts? Here's What’s Going On
articles.description: A February research paper showing AI can unmask pseudonymous internet users is freaking everyone out again this week. Here's what the paper actually says.

articles.title: New York Wants to Ban Polymarket, Lawsuit Calls It 'Illegal Gambling Operation'
articles.description: Attorney General Letitia James and Governor Kathy Hochul allege the prediction market operates without a license and exposes New Yorkers to gambling harms.

articles.title: In Her Final Weeks, SEC's Peirce Calls for Ending the KYC 'Panopticon'
articles.description: In one of her final speeches as commissioner, Peirce argued that regulators' "data haystacks" endanger the people they aim to protect—as recent KYC leaks expose crypto holders to phishing and physical attacks.

articles.title: US Aims to Turn Stablecoins Into a Weapon for Dollar Dominance
articles.description: Washington may fund private stablecoin ventures abroad to protect the dollar's reserve status and prop up Treasury demand.

articles.title: Bitcoin Breakout Cools as Fed Rate-Hike Bets Climb
articles.description: Bitcoin has slipped back below $85,000 after tagging an eight-month high near $87,400 last week, with rising odds of an October Fed hike taking some air out of the rally.

articles.title: £10K Reward Offered After UK Couple Attacked in Crypto Home Invasion
articles.description: Police believe the robbery was planned and targeted, with instructions relayed to the three attackers by a fourth man on a video call.

articles.title: Solana Foundation Hires Binance's Former Global CMO for Institutional Push
articles.description: Rachel Conlan arrives as chief strategy officer and Polygon Labs' Jamal Raees takes over payments, both recruited from elsewhere in crypto.

articles.title: Decrypt Media and FOMO Hour’s Thought Leader Farokh Sarmad to Take Main Stage at NEXTPredict NY Conference
articles.description: Premier Partnership will livestream the Main Stage through Decrypt Media and bring Rug Radio and FOMO HOUR programming onsite.

articles.title: Elliptic Wants Every Cop to Read a Crypto Wallet in Seconds—With AI
articles.description: Elliptic’s new AI-assisted tool, called Pulse, lets any officer input a wallet address or transaction hash and get a plain-language summary in seconds, aiming to bring crypto tracing beyond specialized units.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Selig Says ‘It’s Go Time’ for CFTC Crypto Rules
articles.description: The CFTC has been extremely busy ever since the Clarity Act failed its vote, and it appears they’re ready to accelerate.

articles.title: Q-Day Could Arrive Before Quantum Computers Are Commercially Useful, EU Warns
articles.description: The threat could arrive before quantum computers are commercially useful, and member states have until the end of 2026 to plan for it.

articles.title: Brooklyn Man Who Bragged About $16M Coinbase Scam Gets Up to 12 Years
articles.description: He posed as support staff, emptied about 100 accounts, then lost $6 million of the proceeds gambling, according to his own messages.

articles.title: Anthropic Says Claude Found Something Big in DNA. It Just Doesn't Know What
articles.description: Anthropic says Claude autonomously found a new CRISPR-like enzyme system. Even Dario Amodei admits nobody knows what it actually does.
